items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Then we run and get over to Jimmy Bertrand's. We said about nine o'clock.

ctx.x: now the name is supposed to be spelled S-H-O-F-F-N-E-R N-E-R N-E-R that's right but they have one F? no two Fs two Fs S-H-O-F-F-F Schaff N-E-R and S-C-H-O. And they put C in it.

Yeah, all kind of. We've got the right spelling. Yeah, that's a S-H-O. Double F-M-E-R. Well, I think we better end up. Then we run and get over to Jimmy Bertrand's. We said about nine o'clock. So I certainly appreciate hearing all of that.
